title: Helsinki & Tallinn — June 24–July 4, 2026
description: An 11-day solo trip combining three days of photography-focused exploration in Tallinn's Old Town, four days at WPSC 2026 at Aalto University in Otaniemi, and a Helsinki free day around the Suomenlinna sea fortress.

days.notes: Depart CMI at 6:44pm, connect at ORD (1hr 21min protected connection, T3→T5 via ATS train), then overnight on AA 150 to CDG.

activities.name: Depart CMI — AA 3477 to ORD
activities.description: Envoy Air E170, seat 11D. 1hr 21min layover at ORD; proceed immediately T3→T5 via ATS train.

activities.name: Depart ORD — AA 150 to CDG
activities.description: AA 777, seat 14J. Overnight transatlantic with dinner and breakfast served.

days.notes: Arrive CDG at 12:40pm, 2hr 25min layover, then Finnair to Helsinki arriving 7pm. Check in to Klaus K; light dinner in the Design District.

activities.name: Arrive CDG — Transfer to Finnair
activities.description: 2hr 25min layover in Terminal 2; AA and Finnair both oneworld — follow Finnair transfer signs.

activities.name: Arrive Helsinki (AY 1576)
activities.description: Bolt or tram to Klaus K in the Design District. Check in, freshen up; early night after ~24 hours of travel.

meals.notes: Light dinner near Klaus K; no reservation. Early night recommended.

days.notes: Morning ferry HEL→TLL (~2.5 hrs); check in to Hotel Telegraaf, afternoon Old Town orientation walk, evening dinner at Rataskaevu 16.

activities.name: Ferry HEL → TLL (Tallink / Viking Line)
activities.description: Depart from Länsiterminaali (West Harbour), arrive Tallinn D-Terminal ~2.5 hrs later. Bolt to Hotel Telegraaf (~€6) on arrival.

activities.name: Old Town Orientation Walk
activities.description: Town Hall Square, Müürivahe wall street, and Viru Gates — scout dawn photography positions. Pre-dinner cocktail at the Telegraaf bar.

activities.name: Patkuli / Kohtuotsa Viewpoint — Evening
activities.description: Glowing sky in near-darkness; Old Town rooftops and harbor almost empty at this hour.

meals.dish: Elk, dark rye bread, Estonian flavors
meals.notes: Warm candlelit room; allow 2 hours. Booked via website.

days.notes: Photography priority day — 5:30am dawn shoot at Patkuli and Kohtuotsa, Old Town morning, Kalamaja afternoon, Noa Chef's Hall dinner.

activities.name: Dawn Shoot — Patkuli & Kohtuotsa Viewpoints
activities.description: Panoramic Lower Town and harbor from Patkuli (Rahukohtu tn 5), then Kohtuotsa (Kohtu tn 12) for the complementary angle and 'Tallinn' sign. Descend via Pikk jalg, the city's most photogenic medieval street.

activities.name: Lower Old Town — Müürivahe, Town Hall Square, St. Olaf's Tower
activities.description: Medieval wall and sweater market at Müürivahe; Gothic ironwork at Town Hall Square; €5 rooftop climb at St. Olaf's Church for an elevated city view.

activities.name: Kalamaja Neighborhood & Lennusadam
activities.description: 20-min walk or Bolt northwest: pastel wooden houses and café culture on Kalma Street, then Lennusadam Seaplane Harbour Museum inside a spectacular early-20th-century industrial hangar.

meals.restaurant: Old Town café or bakery — Pikk Street
meals.notes: Light walk-in lunch; no reservation needed.
Michelin-starred; sea cliff setting on the Gulf of Finland with Baltic evening light. Bolt ~10 min (~€8); allow 3 hours. Reservation required.

days.notes: Slower morning with final Old Town photography, Telliskivi Creative City midday, Baltic Station Market lunch, and a relaxed F-Hoone dinner.

activities.name: Final Old Town Photography — Morning Light
activities.description: Slower start; photograph the Old Town in softer morning light before crowds arrive.

activities.name: Telliskivi Creative City
activities.description: Converted industrial buildings with street art, design shops, and murals along Telliskivi tänav — a strong contrast to the medieval Old Town.

activities.name: Kadriorg Park (optional)
activities.description: Baroque palace park and KUMU Art Museum, 30 min walk east — or rest and edit photos at the hotel.

activities.name: Final Tallinn Night Walk
activities.description: Quiet lanes and glowing 10 PM sky; stone walls in warm amber light before the morning ferry back.

meals.dish: Estonian black bread, fresh produce, local dairy, gua bao at Baojaam
meals.notes: The most local food experience of the Tallinn stay; walk-in market.
Casual, industrial-chic space in Telliskivi Creative City (Telliskivi 60a); eclectic European menu and great beer. Walk-in, no booking needed.

days.notes: Morning ferry TLL→HEL; Suomenlinna sea fortress midday, Old Market Hall lunch, Senate Square afternoon, and dinner at Nokka.

activities.name: Ferry TLL → HEL (Tallink / Viking Line)
activities.description: Bolt to D-Terminal Lootsi 13; ~2.5 hrs crossing. Bolt from West Harbour to Scandic Grand Central (~€15–20) to drop bags.

activities.name: Suomenlinna Sea Fortress
activities.description: HSL ferry every 15–20 min (~€3.20) from Market Square pier; 15-min crossing. Allow 2.5–3 hrs: King's Gate, cannon batteries, clifftop path on Pikku Mustasaari for the best Helsinki skyline view, and optional Submarine Vesikko.

activities.name: Senate Square & Uspenski Cathedral
activities.description: Helsinki Cathedral's neoclassical white dome and Senate Square; then Uspenski Cathedral's red-brick Orthodox exterior from the harbor inlet.

meals.dish: Salmon soup, Baltic herring, Finnish cheese, cloudberry
meals.notes: 2-min walk from the ferry landing at Market Square; walk-in Mon–Sat. Allow a full hour.
Kanavaranta 7F; 20-min waterfront walk or short Bolt. One of the few Helsinki fine-dining spots open Mondays; allow 2.5 hours.

days.notes: Conference Day 1 at Aalto University (Otaniemi); evening Michelin dinner at Finnjävel Salonki.

activities.name: WPSC 2026 — Conference Day 1 (Aalto University)
activities.description: Metro to Aalto University (~20–25 min from city center); Alvar Aalto campus buildings worth photographing between sessions.

meals.notes: At Kunsthalle Helsinki; 15–20 min walk or tram from Scandic Grand Central. Most distinctly Finnish fine dining — traditional dishes reimagined with Michelin precision. Allow 3 hours; reservation required.

days.notes: Conference Day 2; afternoon snack at the iconic Café Regatta waterfront cottage, casual Hietalahti Market Hall dinner.

activities.name: WPSC 2026 — Conference Day 2 (Aalto University)
activities.description: Full day of sessions; return to city center by late afternoon.

activities.name: Café Regatta — Afternoon Snack
activities.description: Iconic red waterfront cottage at Merikannontie 8; cinnamon buns, open fires, and Helsinki harbor views. 20-min walk or short Bolt from Scandic Grand Central; walk-in.

meals.notes: Lönnrotinkatu 34; casual covered market with local vendors. Deliberate low-key night after consecutive Michelin-level dinners; walk-in, no reservation.

days.notes: Conference Day 3; second visit to Old Market Hall at lunch; flexible evening — options include Lappi Ravintola or Design District wander.

activities.name: WPSC 2026 — Conference Day 3 (Aalto University)
activities.description: Full day of sessions.

activities.name: Design District Wander (optional)
activities.description: Independent restaurants and wine bars on Bulevardi; 15-min walk from Scandic Grand Central.

meals.restaurant: Old Market Hall (Vanha Kauppahalli) — Second Visit
meals.notes: Explore vendors not covered on Jun 29; walk-in.
Annankatu 22; traditional Lappish cuisine — reindeer and cloudberry in a log-cabin interior. A good fit if not doing the Design District.

days.notes: Final WPSC 2026 sessions; farewell Michelin dinner at Demo (or slow Design District evening as alternative).

activities.name: WPSC 2026 — Conference Day 4 (Final Sessions)
activities.description: Final morning at Aalto University; return to city by early afternoon.

activities.name: South Harbor Late Walk (optional)
activities.description: Amber 10 PM sky over the harbor with the cathedral in the background — final Helsinki skyline photograph.

meals.notes: Uudenmaankatu 9–11; Helsinki Michelin classic since 2003 — relaxed and intimate with a strong wine cellar. Reservation required.

days.notes: Unhurried morning: Temppeliaukio Rock Church and Saturday harbor market, then airport for the 4:25pm departure home via ORD.

accommodation.name: Scandic Grand Central Helsinki (checkout by noon)

activities.name: Temppeliaukio Church (Rock Church)
activities.description: Lutherinkatu 3, 15-min walk; church carved into bedrock with a copper dome and extraordinary natural light — prime interior photography. Small entrance fee, no reservation needed.

activities.name: Saturday Kauppatori Harbor Market
activities.description: Lively waterfront market; photogenic and convenient before heading to the airport.

activities.name: Depart for Helsinki Airport
activities.description: Airport Express train from Central Station (2-min walk from Scandic Grand Central): ~30 min, €6.10. Aim to clear security by 2:15–2:30pm for the 4:25pm AA 8987 (Finnair A330) to ORD.

meals.restaurant: Café near Esplanadi or Central Station
meals.notes: Slow café breakfast; walk-in, convenient to Scandic Grand Central and the airport train.
